Fixed Asset — Transactions

This screen displays all transactions related to a specific fixed asset throughout its lifecycle.

Use this view to track the complete financial history of an individual fixed asset from acquisition to disposal.

Types of Transactions

Transactions shown here include the initial purchase or acquisition of the asset, any improvements or additions that increase its value, and the eventual disposal when the asset is sold or written off.

Common transaction types include purchases, capital improvements, asset revaluations, and disposals.

Transaction Details

Each transaction shows the date, description, and amount that affects the fixed asset's acquisition cost.

The transactions are displayed in chronological order, making it easy to track the complete history of the asset from acquisition to disposal.

The running balance shows the cumulative acquisition cost after each transaction.

To learn more about fixed assets, see: Fixed Asset — Edit
